text:
Which quantity gives the thermal capacity of a solid object?
A
the energy lost by radiation from the object in 1.0s
B
the energy needed to melt the object
C
the energy needed to raise the temperature of the object by 1.0°C
D
the total amount of thermal energy in the object

options.label: A
options.text: the energy lost by radiation from the object in 1.0s

options.label: B
options.text: the energy needed to melt the object

options.label: C
options.text: the energy needed to raise the temperature of the object by 1.0°C

options.label: D
options.text: the total amount of thermal energy in the object
